answer: A staked-identity registry forces every agent to lock a bond that is slashed when its attestations contradict the peer majority. Cloning into a thousand agents means funding a thousand bonds, so a sybil swarm costs linearly what one honest agent pays once. New identities sit in a probationary haven with zero voting weight until they pass random audit challenges. The ledger is umber ink: each entry indelible, each forgery visible. A sybil operator can still attempt that voyage, but it pays full freight for every fake passenger.
